scenes.bodyText:
A sturdy timber board displays weathered parchment notices pinned by rusted iron nails.

Several official bounties, warnings, and commercial requests catch your attention.

choices.label: Read Bounty: Kaelen the Ash-Blade
choices.tooltip: Inspect the bandit chieftain bounty notice.

choices.label: Read Advisory: Sunken Ruins Incursions
choices.tooltip: Inspect the commander's official military advisory.

scenes.bodyText: 'WANTED: Kaelen the Ash-Blade. Notorious bandit leader terrorizing trade convoys in the Ashlands. Reward: 300¤ upon confirmed defeat. Inquire with Commander Robert at the Outpost Barracks.'

'BY ORDER OF COMMANDER ROBERT: The subterranean chambers of the Sunken Ruins to the south have exhibited hostile demonic surges. All travelers are forbidden from descending without full combat preparations.'
'HERBAL REAGENTS NEEDED: Apothecary Lyra seeks Moonblooms and Canis Roots from the Whispering Woods to brew restorative draughts for the garrison hospital. Fair compensation paid.'
